background: Metro Bank is a UK high-street challenger bank founded on a branch-led model, funded by retail and business deposits and lending on mortgages, commercial property and to smaller companies, recapitalised and controlled by a Colombian investor after its capital crisis.
synthesis: One of the three main agencies rates the bank, at BB on a positive outlook, after a one-notch upgrade on 12 Aug 2026; this is sub-investment grade. Capital is the weak spot, with CET1 of 12.3% in the bottom quarter of UK mid-sized banks and down 0.6 points since 30 Jun 2024, though leverage has risen 3.2 points since 31 Dec 2022 to 7.4%. Liquidity is plentiful, with LCR of 288% and NSFR of 159% both in the top quarter and both up strongly since 30 Jun 2023. The rating is moving the right way, but from a low base.
